reviews.title: Mascara is great (but no more brown?)

Okay, one thing: according to a Blinc CSR the Medium Brown shade has been discontinued. There isn't even a Dark Brown shade anymore. Why, Blinc? With light skin and hair tones, Medium Brown gave me a natural look. I really miss it! Black is good for dramatic eyes, the Dark Green is so dark you can only see green in the brightest light, and the Dark Blue is NOT dark, it really does look very blue even in moderate light. (Someday I will have to try Dark Purple, but if it is as bright a shade as the blue, it may not work for me.) Thanks for the great mascara, Blinc, now bring back Medium Brown!

reviews.body: This stuff is seriously amazing! I have 3 serious issues when it comes to eye makeup: oily skin, sensitive eyes, and I live in a hot humid climate. No amount of waterproofing, priming, etc. was ever enough to stop me from looking like a red-eyed raccoon at the end of the work day (not cute at all). So, when I saw a YouTuber raving about Blinc, I figured I might as well try it since I'd already tried pretty much everything else out there. I tried it out at home on a Sunday (before being brave enough to wear it to work). Put it on first thing in the morning, did some chores, went to the gym, ran some errands...15 hours later it still looked fresh! No flaking, no smudges, no burning sensation. I'm seriously obsessed and hope that Blinc never changes this formula because it's PERFECTION!

reviews.title: Excellent Product If Used Properly
reviews.body:
Be sure you read the insert to your bottle with exact guidelines to get the most out of your blinc mascara. There are a few extra steps you need to take to ensure your bottle doesn’t break at the neck.

The product itself is THE BEST. I have zero flakes, no dark circles under my eyes and the removal process actually feels nice on my eyes.

I have worn this running in the rain, working outdoors, in an office setting and in an indoor warehouse physical type of job as well as to banquets, dates, parties and overall fun! They stay PUT until you decide to take them off. 

I don’t recommend sleeping in them. Your lashes will stick to your face! Found this out myself. Just being lazy and not taking the time to wash my face before bed.

The customer service (when I had a problem) helped me figure out what was happening (the tube neck was coming off of the container and it made an absolute mess). I originally purchased this from a small retail shop and they did not know why I was experiencing the problem. 

I will always use this product and recommend it to everyone.

Last year, one of the women posted that she loved this Blinc mascara, especially on the bike, where the wind can make your eyes tear, and your mascara ends up on your cheeks like anti-glare smudge that athletes use. It's not a good look! 
So I decided to order a tube and try it. I have to be careful what I wear near my eyes because even certain lash glues will irritate my eyes. I got the mascara, and tried it for the first time - I LOVE it!! It stays put just like the claims, until you take it off. And when you take it off, it COMES OFF. No raccoon eyes the next morning from leftover mascara, no need for eye makeup remover that also irritates my eyes. 
I wear contacts, and have no issues with the mascara interacting with my contacts. When I ride, and the wind makes my eyes tear, or when the pollen gets to me and my eyes are all runny, the mascara stays put. LOVE THIS STUFF!

However, since investing in a blinc mascara my problem with smudging has gone away. My makeup looks freshers for much longer and I've had compliments about how my makeup still looked in place. Occasionally I'll have some fallout in the shape of flakes of dry mascara falling under my eye but they're very easily removed and it doesn't ruin the look.

Admittedly this mascara is more expensive than what I'm used to but I felt it was definitely worth the money so I will be buying again.

I highly recommend this product for anyone who has issues with their mascara smudging because this product will definitely be a life saver.

reviews.author: No E.
reviews.title: The Perfect Answer for Me
reviews.body: I have been using the Blinc mascara product in the Dark Blue and Dark Purple colors for a few years, having accidentally discovering the product on another website. I was looking for a replacement for a waterproof product that had been discontinued after many loyal years of use. I have genetic dark circles under my eyes, combined with oily to combination skin and cannot afford to use a product that contributes and highlights those negatives, let alone struggle with removal at the end of the day. In addition, I am the emotional type, easily led to tears when frustrated, hurt or sad, and trying to fight back tears results in a mess you wouldn't believe, even the waterproof product I had previously used would put fibers (?) in my eyes and make things even worse. I am glad I tried the Blinc Mascara, I will use no other. I hope that it is available for the rest of my life! Application was a bit tricky to get used to at first, but quickly became second nature. The colors are nicely understated and suitable for everyday use, or you can quickly apply a second coat along with an eyeliner and have a more dramatic look. This product does not irritate my (lasik corrected vision dryness) eyes and is amazingly simple to remove. One of the other best things about this product is that if I don't feel like removing makeup before bedtime (yikes!), still no raccoon eyes on me or product on the pillowcase in the morning! I cannot say enough about how much I love this product. If you are on the fence, I would advise giving this product a try.

Easy to remove but even water splashed on the face will not remove it! However, it is simple and easy to remove at the end of the day! I love this mascara! Since I bought it for a special occasion, I wasn't planning on continuing to use it. However, what I discovered is that I loved the product so much, I now wear nothing else! Other mascaras would migrate into the eye and cause irritation to my sensitive lids, irritating my eyes so much that sometimes an eye infection would develop and I would have to use eye drops to clear it up. I can honestly say since I have used Blinc mascara exclusively I have had no issues with irritation! It is a bit different when applying this wonderful mascara than others, one sweep and you're done.... layering it on is not necessary! I love this mascara and the tube lasts a long time! I feel it is a good value for the price.
